# CustomGPT Documentation

> CustomGPT creates your own custom ChatGPT chatbot with all your business content. You then get accurate, trusted ChatGPT responses from your content without making up facts. All within a secure, privacy-first, business-grade platform. Trusted by MIT, Adobe, Dropbox and 4000+ businesses.
